about_short_description.short_description: Duckly is an IDE plugin for developers that offers to talk, share their code, server, terminal, and collaborate in real-time services.

product.name: Duckly IDE Plugin
product.description: An IDE plugin enabling developers to collaborate in real-time by sharing code, servers, terminals, and communicating via audio and video within their preferred IDE.

product.name: Duckly Web IDE
product.description: A web-based IDE embedded in Duckly's platform that allows users to join coding sessions and collaborate without installing any IDE plugins.

product.name: Duckly Terminal Sharing
product.description: A terminal integration tool that allows developers to share terminal sessions securely during Duckly calls.
